A '''Chiss Ruling Family''' was active on the isolated colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Schesa/Legends|Schesa]], located along the [[Way of Schesa]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. It fell on the losing side of a [[Chiss civil conflict|civil conflict]] before the [[Swarm War]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

{{Chiss-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This unidentified family was first mentioned on page 223 of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', in the collective description of the planets [[Catlia]], [[Massoss/Legends|Massoss]], [[Sharb/Legends|Sharb]], [[Noris/Legends|Noris]], [[Schesa/Legends|Schesa]] and [[Ornfra/Legends|Ornfra]].
